claims: Recheck serum potassium and replace potassium as ordered, given persistent hypokalemia (3.1–3.7 mEq/L) on active potassium chloride orders.
Monitor blood glucose and treat hyperglycemia per protocol, given glucose 134 mg/dL and active insulin/dextrose orders.
Assess and manage severe pain (pain score 8) with the ordered IV opioid analgesia and reassess response.
Continue broad-spectrum antibiotics (piperacillin-tazobactam, metronidazole) for suspected infection given leukocytosis (WBC 16.5 K/uL).

Monitor arterial blood pressure and heart rate, given borderline mean arterial pressures (59–78 mmHg) and active metoprolol order.
Recheck serum magnesium and replace as ordered, given magnesium 1.8–2.0 mg/dL on active magnesium sulfate orders.
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit for anemia (Hgb 12.0–12.6 g/dL, Hct 34.8–36.9%) and transfuse if clinically indicated.
Perform delirium and sedation assessments (CAM-ICU, RASS) and maintain orientation, given fluctuating RASS and orientation scores.
Continue maintenance IV fluids (lactated Ringer's at 100 mL/hour) and monitor electrolytes and renal function.
